Triage: lands in area:ux · domain:ui · Feature · priority:p2 · `pm:queue` · size XS; rationale: on a read-only package, the resource list's New button stays enabled although the shell shows a lock. A follow-up of #37456 under topic #37424; p2.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzywxH36FPH6ayWMUe

Premise corrected (read at origin/main c3da7536). This card says the list's New "stays enabled" on a read-only package. It does not:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx`: `canCreateHere` requires `(!host?.readOnly || createInPair)`; without a pair, New is not drawn.
- With a pair (`createInPair`, set by `StudioMetadataArea.tsx` as `readOnly && !kernel && !!customization && !customization.walled`), New is enabled on purpose and creates into the base's `.custom` pair (ADR-0146 D3; #36897).
- The path the card names (`views/studio-design/**`) is not where the button lives.

Target kept (the maintainer's decision 8 on #37424: "plus a tooltip on \"New\""); fix changed: New is not disabled; on a read-only base with a pair it gets a tooltip that says the item goes to the `.custom` package. Folded into #37918 (phase 2-1, the list page), which carries the corrected item and its tests.
